acceptance_criteria.text: Status messages tell each player whose turn it is, which mark they hold, and the game outcome, and state syncs automatically to connected clients.

provenance.source_note: The owner fixed `node --test` as the exact regression command in the constraints and verification answers.

acceptance_criteria.text: The exact command node --test passes using only the Node standard library: unit tests cover the pure game rules (turn order, move legality, win and draw detection, reset) and WebSocket frame encoding/decoding as pure functions, plus exactly one HTTP smoke test that starts the server on an ephemeral port, fetches the client page, and closes the server. No test opens a live WebSocket connection; every test closes what it opens so the run exits on its own.
